caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table set against a plain, light beige background. The table is rectangular with slightly curved corners and edges, and features a warm reddish-brown wood grain. Around the edges of the table is a thin, lighter-colored border, possibly representing inlaid wood or a decorative trim. The table has two legs, each forming a T-shape, with each vertical segment branching out into two slightly curved supports at the base, ending with small brass or gold-colored feet. Under the tabletop, on the front-facing side, there are two drawers with round dark knobs, separated by a thin central divider, and the drawer panels are bordered with thin gold lines. The entire piece has a polished, glossy appearance, and the shadowing is minimal, with no other objects or features in the drawing.
title: Table
